name: Pallof Press
steps: Set a handle at chest height and stand side-on to the cable machine.
Step away until the cable is tight, holding the handle at your chest.
Stand with feet hip width and knees soft, stomach braced.
Press the handle straight out and hold for 2 seconds without turning.
Bring it back to your chest; switch sides after the set.
cues: Do not let the cable twist you
Press straight out from the chest

common_mistakes.fix: Use a lighter weight and brace harder
Stand tall with weight even on both feet
Hold the arms out for 2 seconds each rep
